messages.displayText:
Think I’ll let Pokémon handle
the high-up deliveries...

We’ve gotta drive at a crawl around here.
Pokémon might run into the road at any second.

Should I attack from afar
or get up close first?

If you look in different places, you’ll find different
Pokémon living there.
Are there rare Pokémon here in Lumiose?

I’ll buy as many clothes as it takes to find the
pieces that I truly love!

Boutique Couture is one of Lumiose’s fanciest
shops, you know?

It’s no surprise hotels are pricey in
a destination city like Lumiose...

Good Pokémon battlers
are good deal closers!

Clefairy’s strange, otherworldly charm has won it
many fans.

Some moves take longer
to get ready than others.

No way could I be a backpacker without Pokémon
I can depend on!

Of course I’m different. How could anyone not
change in 10 years?

Has it really been 10 years?!
You don’t look a bit different!

Help keep Lumiose beautiful—
smash every Mega Crystal you see!

Gonna take Vernal
Avenue at a full sprint!

We should all train with the Fist of Justice. You
never know when being prepared might save you.

Whenever you’re heading into a wild zone, you’d
best be prepared. Check your items and such.

Having more Pokémon in the city
creates more jobs for us people!

I was hoping to go sunbathe on the roof, but
some Pokémon got there first.

Seeing the Stone Emporium always makes me
think... Why do Pokémon react to certain stones?

Our galettes are the
talk of Lumiose. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Pokémon love our bread
more than any other!

Sure, it’s sad to see the city I love change...but it’s
sweeter yet to consider what it might become!

Classes take forever!
They’re so boring!

With all the wild Pokémon around, it’s kinda like
we’re living in nature in the middle of the city!

When I’ve got my Pokémon,
life always feels luxurious!

Daytime’s when I train my
Pokémon for the Z-A Royale.

Where should we go the next time we all have a
day off together?
A wild zone!
I wanna watch the Z-A Royale!

Wait, you let your Pokémon out of their Poké Balls
at your place?

I like to let my Pokémon out of their Poké Balls,
but then they take over my bed...

Racine Construction
has a whimsical side.

A scaffolding
obstacle course?!

Lumiose has been around a long time. A lot of the
shops here have become pretty famous.

Trends live and die so quickly in Lumiose... Even
the very word “stylish” feels like a relic these days.

Ground types are weak to...
Water, Grass, and Ice! ♪

Rumor has it that if you gather those <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>screws<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> lying
around on the scaffolding and take ’em to Racine<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Construction, you can trade ’em for nice things.

It’s a lucky thing when each day
is the same as the day before.

You gotta change with the times!
This holo-tech stuff is fantastic!

What makes a Pokémon battle artistic? It’s a
difficult question...

I feel like me an’ my Pokémon
are invincible today!

You can’t walk these streets without meeting
someone or something—for better or worse.

Maybe this city—where we live in
harmony with Pokémon—is art...

I don’t think I can take care
of more than three Pokémon...

My arm’s itchin’ to
throw a Poké Ball!

Lumiose City’s always in SOME kind of trouble.
Remember that huge blackout a few years ago?

Ohhh, Vernal Avenue...
Ohhh, Vernal Avenue... ♪

Thank goodness I’m still fit enough to enjoy
strolling about sampling Lumiose’s lovely food!

Press <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus to use your camera!
Preserve your memories in photos!

I’ve got a meeting with Quasartico
about the redevelopment plan.

I am afraid Boutique Couture is for none but the
truly stylish.

Oho! So stylish—you’re just the sort we like to see
here at Boutique Couture.

I’m gonna be the kind of guy who
brings out the best in Spewpa!

Using moves with a wide attack radius to smash
a bunch of Mega Crystals at once feels great!

What’s the name for someone
born and raised here? Lumiosian?

You don’t have to use just one Pokémon... Isn’t
teamwork part of battling?

When you’ve got just one Pokémon, going up
against a type it’s weak to is ROUGH.

I’d like to come back here once the
urban redevelopment work’s done.

I can’t even remember what this
place used to look like anymore...

I’ve got to go undercover and infiltrate this Z-A
Royale thing that happens at night...

It’s amazing how Pokémon can find their own
little spots they like, even in the middle of the city.

When I bring out my Pokémon, wild Pokémon
notice and come to check it out.

I guess the Pokémon want to feel out how strong
others are.

Wish this urban redevelopment
plan included fixing up my house.

Is anyone studying the impact of
having more wild Pokémon here?

Parcels with Pokémon food in ’em
attract attention—the hungry sort.

I gotta learn what moves wild
Pokémon know to protect myself!

This place feels pretty different
from the last time I visited.

Some terrifying Pokémon lurk in Lumiose’s back
alleys...

My wheels got dinged by a Pokémon move.
Wonder if insurance covers that...?

Some Pokémon will evolve as they gain
Exp. Points and level up!

I love playing tag with Pokémon!
I’ve caught ’em seven times today!

Feels kinda like we’re all
living in a Safari Zone lately.

I could travel round the world
as long as I’ve got my Pokémon!

Great Balls give you a bit of an
edge in catching Pokémon.

Maybe I’ll have my
Pokémon hold a Berry...

I love collecting TMs, even
if I have no use for ’em!

I wonder if Pokémon change
physically to adapt to urban life.

I don’t bat an eye at the
constant howls anymore.

Those huge Pokémon,
though! With the eyes!

I dress however I like and
train whatever Pokémon I like.

I don’t see many punk guys
and the like around lately.

Pokémon are the real stars.
Trainers are just stagehands.

The most important thing is doing
better than you did yesterday.
My Poké Ball broke...

The Maximizers are coming here
on tour! I simply can’t wait!

It’s getting so you almost can’t
walk around without a Pokémon...

If a move misses, don’t dwell on it.
Believe you’ll succeed next time!

How do Pokémon know what
move we’re telling them to use?

These Mega Crystals—are they in fashion now?
I’ve been seeing them all over Lumiose.

To the people of Lumiose, cafés are where you
meet friends for furious, coffee-fueled debates!

If your moves are all one type, you’ll have no shot
against Pokémon with a type advantage.

You don’t have to worry about that if you go
around with a balanced Pokémon team.

Mega Crystals pop up faster
than I can smash ’em! Why?!

Are artworks with Pokémon motifs more popular
in general?

Well, just having a Pokémon as the subject and
nothing else is hardly new or exciting...

Isn’t it bizarre that we can throw a Poké Ball even
when it’s got a 200-pound Pokémon in it?

It’s a wonder that Poké Balls can be so incredible
and cost only <U+E300>100 apiece.

Can’t anything be done about the
noisy Pokémon on the rooftops?

An intriguing idea. Seeing as you’ve got Greninja
protecting you, I’d support it.

I’d like to sneak out after dark and see Pokémon
playing in the city streets at night!

Hmm. It’s key to consider how close to stay to
your Pokémon during battle.

Things just feel more right the closer I am to my
Pokémon in battle, y’know?

I bet having their Trainer right close by makes
Pokémon feel brave when they need to fight!

Wonder if I can buy Berries
in bulk somewhere...

Should I train one Pokémon a lot
or train up a balanced team?

You can’t win ’em all, so you
gotta be able to lose well!

In the Z-A Royale, striking first
can make all the difference!

DENSOKU sneakers are
the best for running in!

I can’t begrudge the youths
for having time that I don’t.

You can think about battles twenty-four seven,
but that doesn’t guarantee you’ll win!

We’re both very excited to get to see the sights
here in Lumiose, and yet...

When you’re traveling with someone who doesn’t
agree with any of the sights and places you want<U+0010><U+0001>븀
to see, it’s hard to settle on anything!

My place feels cramped now that I
brought home an alpha Pokémon.

I bet Pokémon would be
shook if I mimicked their cries.

What would you do if it
attracted a bunch of ’em?

Some people want to have pedigreed Pokémon. To
each their own, I guess.

I don’t know my Fletchinder’s birthday, so we
celebrate the anniversary of when we met.

Sure, catching a Pokémon makes you its Trainer.
But what matters is whether you act the part!

It’s hard to tell if Pokémon are
wild or if they’re somebody’s!

The best cure for a crushing loss is
fine food and a good night’s sleep.

I think my Canari plush has made
me better at catching Pokémon!

Where was that shop again?
Passage...something or other?

If you take someone’s Pokémon,
that makes you a thief!

I’m different than the furisode
girls from the Johto region.

It’s so hard to decide when it’s
worth risking an Ultra Ball...

I’m sure there’d be demand for a
Pokémon battle tutoring service.

Slowpoke’s Water Gun is
great for cleaning the tub.

Life is like a
twinkling star!

My Pumpkaboo eats like a real gourmand when
we’re in Lumiose.

I’m with the Pokédex Research Society! If I were
to write a Pokédex entry for Vanillish, it’d say...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“Vanillish create their own energy by drinking
water from rivers, lakes, and the like and then<U+0010><U+0001>븀
using their internal organs to produce chilled air.”

I want to be good enough at Pokémon battles to
be able to recover from using a wrong move.

More powerful moves tend to
take a bit longer to fire off.

Berries that halve damage from
supereffective moves are handy!

The more people there are
around, the lonelier I feel...

I’m gonna make friends
with sooo many Pokémon!

If no one picks up litter, wild Pokémon will make
an even bigger mess with it.

Supereffective moves hit with more power...and
even more so when they’re Plus Moves!

Never try to stand in the
way of someone’s dreams!

A ham sandwich with butter
makes a power-packed breakfast.

Everyone should walk more!
You never know what you’ll see!

I’m never sure what item I
should have my Litleo hold.

Oh please! Even with a full party, you always
panic about which one to send out...

With enough Pokémon in your party, you’ll be
able to handle whatever you run into!

Flower nectar looks tasty.
No wonder Pokémon drink it!

Sometimes I just wanna
Fire Blast something...

I wanna make a
team of six alphas!

If people miss my deliveries,
they gotta come pick ’em up.

I’m the type who likes to squeeze
in a quick run during my break.

There’s no point crying if you lose.
Tears don’t water flowers, they say.

How will Prism Tower
transform next, I wonder?

I came to see stuff about Team
Flare, but I’m getting nowhere...
Which is cooler—Pokémon or taxis?

Well, a Skiddo can only carry one rider, but a taxi
can hold a few people, right?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
That doesn’t mean one is better than the other.
It’s more about what you need!

Just imagine...a car that Pokémon
moves can’t smash into tiny bits...

You may think the Society of Battle Connoisseurs
are just idle rich kids. Don’t underestimate them!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Word is they’re powering up their Pokémon with
the best training all their money can buy.

Hit ’em with moves they’re weak to! If you can’t
do that, soften ’em up with moves like Tail Whip!

So...give myself a leg up, and give my opponent a
a leg down! Got it!

I catch all my Pokémon
with plain old Poké Balls.

It’s not like you have to battle
every wild Pokémon you see.

I hired a professional
to train my Pokémon.

If you use a Plus Move that’s super effective, it
hits even harder!

I want an alpha Pokémon
to protect me from stuff!

Straight roads are great!
They beg to be sprinted on!

I want to meet all
kinds of Pokémon!

I got woken up by my
Pokémon’s snoring.

I’ll never forget the
first Pokémon I met.

People and Pokémon alike need to be able to live
freely and be treated the way they deserve.

We can’t see into people’s minds.
All we can do is see each other!

If you get too hung up on not wanting to lose, you
stop battling altogether. That’s not the answer!

Me and my Pokémon battle over
food every meal, morning to night!

I’ve wanted to try a night at
Hotel Richissime my whole life.

It’s hard to explain to tourists
why your city is the way it is...

If everyone started wearing a
furisode like me, I’d blend right in.

No amount of strength training
can beat Pokémon muscles!

I want a Strange Souvenir
from the Alola region!

I have my Pokémon handle the
usual stops on my delivery route.

Do Pokémon actually want to live
alongside people in the first place?

The Pokémon within my Poké Balls...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
They’re looking...at YOU!

So we’ll keep getting more wild zones, eh? Maybe
I oughta try living in one. Guess I’d never get<U+0010><U+0001>븀
lonely surrounded by Pokémon.

There’s too much to see!
I’ll just have to move here!

My partner Houndour knows
moves that work at a distance.

Time you choose to spend
alone is still time well spent.

Trainers need to be trained
just as much as Pokémon do!

What disappears is gone, and
whatever’s left can only remain.

Ever since I was a child, I’ve wondered...why do
cafés flourish so in Lumiose?

I’d say we know the value of taking things slow
and making time to enjoy a nice break in a café.

I’d love to see that exhibition
at the Lumiose Museum!

Did people and Pokémon live
together three thousand years ago?

They say Pokémon you get in trades grow a bit
faster than others.

Perhaps, but I simply don’t want to trade
Pokémon with anybody right now!

I forget what we learned in school,
but I remember Pokémon’s names!

My partners keep getting
stronger and stronger!

Sometimes I manage a whole lap
around Lumiose lost in thought.

My Pokémon at home comes
and goes through the window.

The perpetual flowing of water keeps it clean. I
suppose the city, too, needs to keep on changing.

No way! But Magikarp flop
and splash around so much!

Magikarp are so weak, the
current sweeps ’em downriver!

Maybe I’ll play tag with my
Pokémon around the tower.

Prism Tower’s enormous
size is right and true.

Now that I’ve made it to Centrico
Plaza, I’ll decide where to go.

I wonder if competing to climb ranks will become
more mainstream than collecting badges.

This city must be getting tough for
people who don’t like Pokémon.

Forget living in the districts—
I wanna live in the tower!

I wonder if Ivor from the Fist of
Justice could smash Prism Tower?

Apparently they used to hold quizzes and
Pokémon battles inside Prism Tower.

I heard the siblings who used to rule the tower
were really close.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The brother was a great inventor, and the sister
was an absolute quiz master!

It’d be cool to glide from the
tower with my Rotom Phone...

I heard this lady called Jacinthe
tried to buy the tower for herself!

Wish I could fling all my parcels
from the top of the tower.

So many people come here. It’s
a good place for a battle court!

I’m pretty sure I read Prism Tower is nearly one
thousand feet tall...

The redevelopment plan should
never have closed the city’s symbol.

I should do some kind of street
performance with my Pokémon.

I’d never want to climb the tower,
but I still liked knowing I could...

One day I’ll be even
bigger than Prism Tower!

People and Pokémon gather here
since the tower’s so easy to spot.

Are there bird Pokémon that roost on top of Prism
Tower?

Perhaps some kind of Legendary Pokémon or
something might dare alight upon the tower!

I miss looking over Lumiose
from the observation deck.

Check out Prism Tower!
Why’s it glowing like that?

This is...wild—so wild my
vocabulary’s failing me.

We gotta make
sure everyone’s OK.

Is all this weirdness
Quasartico’s doing?
